description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which manages the UI for the home screen in the music player app. It sets up RecyclerViews for featured and recent tracks, initializes adapters, and collects a flow of tracks from the MusicRepository to update the UI.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays featured and recent music tracks in RecyclerViews, managing their setup and data binding from the MusicRepository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout using view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerViews and adapters, and launches a coroutine to collect track data and update the UI.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears the binding reference to prevent memory leaks.
